"Cute~♪ You're actually pretty good at games, huh?
I might've gained some respect for you. Maybe."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What should I do with this one...
The bed is packed tight... well, I'd crush it anyway.
And that plushie over there is my pillow, so~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"On the desk... nah, it might fall.
Ah, I'll line it up with the polish.
No way I'd treat it carelessly then."
